caption: Figure 3 : Standard LARA (top) vs. LARA++ (bottom). Same 16 query embeddings in both panels; colors mark proposal groups and ⋆ \star the landmark (group mean) defining each proposal. LARA groups contiguous positions, so each group mixes dissimilar queries and the landmarks collapse toward the global mean. LARA++ groups queries by similarity via greedy k k -center clustering, giving tight groups with representative landmarks. The strip below each panel shows the group of each sequence position.
